title: Allotment Planner
summary: Free web app that plans crop rotation for community garden plots, season by season.

data.text: A weekend project for the community garden two streets away. Plot holders draw their beds, pick what they want to grow, and the planner suggests a four year rotation that keeps soil healthy.

data.alt: Allotment Planner grid with crop families colour coded
data.caption: Crop families get a colour each, so a rotation reads at a glance.

data.text: It works offline in a browser, because the garden has no signal, and stores everything on the device. More than 120 plots have been planned with it.
